description: Rewrites temporal_stability_enrichment to achieve >20 distinct scores. Current v1 has 4 distinct values (30-90 range), insufficient discrimination per signal quality diagnostic. MUST read MULTIPLE metadata fields: registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars, last_updated_iso, commit_frequency, issue_response_time_days. Score freshness bonus for recent commits, stability bonus for long-lived repos with consistent update cadence. MUST NOT write DB or import protected modules. Pure compute_score(metadata) -> (float, dict). Include parse_iso_date, compute_days_between helpers. Exit 0 on self-smoke with >=3 test cases.
